evidence: Changes shared argument and settings handling across startup and init in 16 files.
rationale: This PR fixes a pervasive hazard in argument parsing where negating options led to assertion crashes, command execution of '0', and unintended network connections. Commit 512773d111 highlights that '-limitclustercount=0 or -nolimitclustercount passed the upper bound check and triggered an assertion in TxGraph', while other commits cite '-norpcpassword set the RPC password to "0"' and commands executing '0'. Resolving these counterintuitive behaviors by introducing explicit opt-in negation semantics eliminates a significant recurring source of configuration bugs across the node.
